title: Spooky Buster Halloween Blaster
description: A futuristic Halloween-themed blaster weapon with a purple body, orange barrel, and various ornaments including pumpkins, spiderwebs, tombstones, skulls, candles, and a small cauldron.

composition.orientation: diagonal, with the muzzle pointing toward the upper left

object_details.name: Spooky Buster
object_details.body: Angular purple weapon body with gold accents, styled in the shape of a coffin.
object_details.barrel: Large orange barrel featuring a cracked Halloween pumpkin tip with a black hole at the muzzle.
decorations: small tombstone with 'RIP' engraved on top
turquoise pixelated smoke or flame effects
small black cauldron containing glowing green liquid, suspended by a chain
melted white candles at the base of the orange tube
transparent container filled with orange candy-like items
white fangs on the right side
small flashlight casting a warm white glow

animations.idle: The small black cauldron sways gently with player movement, white candles emit a subtle flickering light animation, and turquoise pixel smoke continuously flows from the pumpkin muzzle.
animations.firing: Standard AUG recoil push backwards, accompanied by a burst of turquoise pixel smoke erupting from the pumpkin barrel and rattling the chained cauldron.
animations.reload: Standard bullpup AUG reload sequence; the player detaches the transparent candy container downward and inserts a fully loaded fresh candy container.
animations.aim_down_sights: Camera perspective shifts to align directly over the 'RIP' tombstone sight.

visible_text.location: right side of the weapon body

visual_style.look: hand-painted game asset with beveled geometry

lighting: Soft lighting with warm reflections on the orange surfaces and a subtle rim light on the purple body.
